title: Fabula Ultima Dice
description: JRPG dice for every roll: real 3D dice (pixel-art or smooth) thrown across the screen with physics, landing on the actual result. Each player picks a preset (Battle UI, 8-bit, and one for every Final Fantasy from VI to XVI) or builds their own: 13 surface textures, colors, trails, landing effects, sounds, and how the dice are thrown, land and leave, with pop-up numbers and a live preview. Pixel dice are crisp and readable, chat results wait until the dice land, Project FU criticals and fumbles get a flourish, and lighter 2D dice are there for older computers.
